title: Actionable Laboratory Recommendations and Parameter Return-on-Investment (ROI) Analysis

parameter_ranking.recommendation: Replace thermal SiO2 with thin high-k ALD dielectric (HfO2 or ZrO2, EOT < 1 nm). Electrostatic accumulation thins the depletion width and reduces Rc by over 30x.
Target metals with work functions aligned to the conduction band (Bi, Sb, Sc). Suppressing Phi_B below 0.15 eV prevents carrier freeze-out.
Use mechanical van der Waals lamination or low-energy sputtering (< 30 eV) to prevent interfacial sulfur vacancy defect creation and Fermi level pinning.
For 3D evaporated metals, choose reactive metals (Ti, Sc) with vacuum annealing (250-300 deg C in Ar/H2) to de-pin the Fermi level via sub-sulfide formation.

parameter_ranking.parameter: MoS2 Flake Layer Thickness (1L vs Few-Layer)
parameter_ranking.recommendation: Few-layer MoS2 (3-5 layers) slightly reduces Rc due to smaller bandgap (1.3 eV vs 1.8 eV) and multiple conduction channels, but cannot compensate for poor gating.
Do not waste time or material evaporating thick metal stacks (> 30 nm). Once the film is continuous, sheet resistance of the pad is negligible compared to the interface.
Semimetals like Bi have 50x higher bulk resistivity than Ag, yet yield 10x lower contact resistance due to interface de-pinning. Ignore bulk conductivity.

decision_hierarchy.guideline: Avoid standard 90nm SiO2 for high-performance devices. Deposit 3-5nm ALD HfO2 or ZrO2 to access n_2D > 1.5e13 cm^-2.

decision_hierarchy.action: Select semimetals or reactive low-workfunction metals
decision_hierarchy.guideline: For lowest Rc (< 100 Ohm*um), use Bi(0001) or Sb(0001). For CMOS foundry compatibility, use Ti/Au or Sc/Au.
Deploy glovebox vdW lamination if possible. If evaporating, use UHV (< 10^-8 Torr), slow rates (0.1 A/s), and cryogenic substrate cooling.

decision_hierarchy.action: Vacuum anneal reactive contacts, encapsulate semimetals
decision_hierarchy.guideline: Anneal Ti/Sc at 250-300 deg C in forming gas. Encapsulate Bi/Sb with 10nm Al2O3 immediately to prevent oxidation in air.

executive_rule_of_thumb: Contact resistance in 2D MoS2 is 90% determined by the interface electrostatics and band alignment (gate dielectric thickness and Schottky barrier), not by the bulk properties of the contact pad.
